summary_en: FY12/2026 year-end dividend raised to ¥140/share (¥280 pre-split) from ¥130/share (¥260 pre-split), increasing annual dividend to ¥280/share (¥560 pre-split). Prior forecast: ¥130/share each interim and year-end. Rationale: progressing toward mid-term plan target of 50% payout ratio and ¥130/share base dividend by FY12/2030; uplifted earnings forecast (net income to ¥6,400M from ¥5,000M) supports increase. Split 2:1 effective 1 Jul 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
Fukuda Corporation revised its FY12/2026 dividend forecast upward. The year-end dividend is increased to ¥140/share (¥280 pre-split) from the prior forecast of ¥130/share (¥260 pre-split), raising the full-year dividend to ¥280/share (¥560 pre-split). The company also lifted its consolidated earnings forecast: net income to ¥6,400M from ¥5,000M, driven by strong order intake and progress on large private building projects, partly offset by material-cost inflation concerns.

The company is executing a 2:1 stock split effective 1 July 2026. The dividend increase is aligned with the medium-term plan 2030 targets of a 50% payout ratio and a ¥130/share base dividend (pre-split), signalling continued progress toward those capital-efficiency and shareholder-return goals.
